name: cond-auto-hero
page_section: conditions/auto-accident-injury :: Auto Accident Injury Care in Roseville

The vertebrae carry no labels: no letters or numbers such as C3 or C7 anywhere. Anatomically accurate.

name: cond-carpal-assess
page_section: conditions/carpal-tunnel :: We follow the nerve from the neck to the fingertip
intended_subject: one whole arm and shoulder with the lower neck vertebrae and the collarbone drawn in outline, and a single fine pale teal nerve traced continuously from the lower neck, under the collarbone, down the inner arm and forearm, through the wrist and into the thumb and first fingers, showing the whole path of the nerve from neck to fingertip. Anatomically accurate.

name: cond-carpal-hero
page_section: conditions/carpal-tunnel :: Carpal Tunnel Treatment in Roseville
intended_subject: the bones of the hand and wrist seen palm-up, with the median nerve drawn as a fine continuous pale teal line running from the forearm through the carpal tunnel beneath a band of ligament across the wrist, and branching into the thumb, index, middle and half of the ring finger. Anatomically accurate.

name: cond-fibro-hero
intended_subject: a full standing human figure seen from behind, drawn in fine outline like an anatomical study (no facial features, no genitals), with eighteen small solid deep-teal dots placed symmetrically at the classic tender points: the base of the skull, the lower neck, the tops of the shoulders, beside the shoulder blades, the elbows, the upper buttocks, the outer hips and the inner knees. Every dot sits ON the body surface exactly at its tender point; no dot floats beside the body. Plain warm cream paper background with no panel, card or frame behind the figure.

name: cond-frozen-hero
page_section: conditions/frozen-shoulder :: Frozen Shoulder Treatment in Roseville
intended_subject: the shoulder joint seen from the front: collarbone, shoulder blade and the upper arm bone hanging down, with a large dotted arc showing the full range the arm should travel overhead and a much shorter solid pale teal arc showing the restricted range it actually reaches. Anatomically accurate.

name: cond-headache-hero

intended_subject: the base of the skull and the top two neck vertebrae (the ring-shaped atlas and the axis with its upright peg) in a three-quarter rear view, showing how the skull rests on the atlas, with the next three cervical vertebrae below. Anatomically accurate.
